name: Pandit Omkarnath Music Competition
benefit:
- Classical music artists are provided with the opportunity to participate in organized competitions for singing, vocal, and percussion performances.
- Competitions are organized separately for two age categories: 12 to 19 years and 20 to 35 years, ensuring age-appropriate competition levels.
- The scheme provides a platform for recognition and promotion of classical music talent in the state of G
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must be between 12 to 19 years of age or between 20 to 35 years of age. - The applicant must be a classical music artist. - The applicant must specialize in singing, vocal performance, or percussion instruments.
